svg.aria-label: Upload sequence with two parallel flows from client 1. Metadata flow: 1 client 1 sends the new file's metadata to the API servers, 2 which store it with status pending, 3 tell the notification service, and 4 client 2 learns a file is being uploaded. File content flow: 2.1 client 1 sends the content to block servers, 2.2 which upload blocks to cloud storage, 2.3 cloud storage calls back the API servers, 2.4 the status becomes uploaded, 2.5 the notification service is told, and 2.6 client 2 learns the file is ready.
svg.title: Upload sequence
